objects.name: audit_logs
objects.redacted_explanation: Audit history is retained with redaction and actor mapping; backup-control audit cutoff is verified separately.

objects.name: egress_private_exceptions
objects.redacted_explanation: User and instance references require target mapping; destination policy must be revalidated.

objects.name: northbound_admin_settings
objects.redacted_explanation: Authentication and instance-management settings require A and B review and target-side reference validation.

objects.name: northbound_settings_audit
objects.redacted_explanation: Settings audit history is confidential and requires actor and target-setting reference verification.

objects.name: schema_migrations
objects.redacted_explanation: Only applied filenames and the catalog hash are referenced; source rows and DDL are never restored.

objects.name: security_scan_configs
objects.redacted_explanation: Scanner configuration is restored only after target analyzers and actor references are validated.

objects.name: security_scan_job_items
objects.redacted_explanation: Job and asset references require target mapping; nonterminal work is normalized to a non-running state.

objects.name: security_scan_jobs
objects.redacted_explanation: Historical scan jobs may contain sensitive findings and actor references; nonterminal state cannot resume implicitly.

objects.name: security_scan_reports
objects.redacted_explanation: Reports are confidential and remain valid only when their restored job and asset references verify.

objects.name: system_artifact_lease_states
objects.redacted_explanation: The per-source lease mode and generation guard is target-local coordination metadata that makes shared and delete leases mutually exclusive without storing provider content.

objects.name: system_artifact_leases
objects.redacted_explanation: Artifact leases are target-local coordination facts with typed source and holder IDs; no provider locator, credential or restore inventory is persisted.

objects.name: system_backup_alert_states
objects.redacted_explanation: Low-cardinality persisted alert sequences survive controller restarts but contain no resource public IDs, free labels or owner payloads.

objects.name: system_backup_artifact_verifications
objects.redacted_explanation: Artifact verification rows retain task state, observed hashes and typed evidence references without embedding provider locations or verifier payloads.

objects.name: system_backup_attempts
objects.redacted_explanation: Attempt history is a target-local execution ledger with typed task and phase references; runner jobs, check bodies and provider details are not restored.

objects.name: system_backup_check_results
objects.redacted_explanation: The shared verifier envelope is target-local control metadata; owner-defined check registries and expected/actual payload schemas remain external and are never reconstructed from restored rows.

objects.name: system_backup_compact_tombstones
objects.redacted_explanation: Compact tombstones preserve redacted idempotency and terminal hashes for control-plane safety; source operation rows are not reconstructed.

objects.name: system_backup_configs
objects.redacted_explanation: Immutable configuration versions contain only closed scalar policy and redacted identity/version references; provider and security material is never restored.

objects.name: system_backup_dependency_health
objects.redacted_explanation: Observed dependency health and immutable-version evidence are target-local control facts and are referenced without restoring stale observations.

objects.name: system_backup_events
objects.redacted_explanation: Events are an append-only redacted diagnostic projection with closed detail fields; they never restore or replace owner task, operation or lifecycle authority.

objects.name: system_backup_evidence
objects.redacted_explanation: Evidence metadata remains a typed, encrypted control reference; neither payload bytes nor provider storage references are restored as business data.

objects.name: system_backup_evidence_chunks
objects.redacted_explanation: Chunk framing and integrity metadata is meaningful only with its evidence record and is referenced for verification, never replayed into a target.

objects.name: system_backup_external_actions
objects.redacted_explanation: External-action rows preserve exact immutable non-secret request bytes, deterministic keys and provider observation hashes; replayable credentials and provider execution remain external.

objects.name: system_backup_installation_state
objects.redacted_explanation: Installation identity and first-enabled history are referenced for monitoring and matrix transitions; source rows are never restored.

objects.name: system_backup_job_observations
objects.redacted_explanation: Current Job generation, relay cursor, progress age and command slot are installation-local execution facts; B-owned message wire and Job execution are not restored or defined by D.

objects.name: system_backup_log_chunks
objects.redacted_explanation: Only redacted log indexes and evidence references are retained for diagnostics; workload logs are not restored or resumed.

objects.name: system_backup_operations
objects.redacted_explanation: Operation rows are the target-local idempotency and orchestration ledger; actor scope, hashes and typed result references are retained without replaying mutations.

objects.name: system_backup_preflights
objects.redacted_explanation: Preflight rows retain closed orchestration state and evidence references only; check bodies and restore-target content remain with their implementing owners.

objects.name: system_backup_promotions
objects.redacted_explanation: Promotion records are installation-local baseline CAS facts containing typed resource and immutable evidence hashes; current health is always derived and no provider, runner or signing payload is copied.

objects.name: system_backup_provider_capabilities
objects.redacted_explanation: Capability probes are bound to an exact provider identity and reference version; target capability state must be observed again rather than restored.

objects.name: system_backup_prune_items
objects.redacted_explanation: Prune items freeze typed object-version or catalog-tombstone identities and D-owned lifecycle state without storing provider locators, credentials or catalog payload bytes.

objects.name: system_backup_prune_runs
objects.redacted_explanation: Prune runs are installation-local candidate, confirmation, idempotency and CAS ledgers; strong-auth proof material and provider deletion payloads remain with their owners.

objects.name: system_backup_source_writer_check_states
objects.redacted_explanation: Writer-inventory checks retain only versioned registry hashes, domain inventory hashes, bounded difference counts and registered evidence; every target installation must observe the writers again.

objects.name: system_backup_staging_resources
objects.redacted_explanation: Staging intents, resource ownership, immutable identity and cleanup lifecycle are target-local control metadata; resource bytes and source data are never restored from these rows.

objects.name: system_backup_strong_auth_nonces
objects.redacted_explanation: Consumed nonce HMACs and request hashes are installation-local authentication replay records, never restored or exposed as proof material; A-owned verifier and wire contract remain pending.

objects.name: system_backups
objects.redacted_explanation: Backup task rows are target-local orchestration and immutable artifact-reference metadata; workload capture, security material and provider implementations are not restored.

objects.name: system_image_settings
objects.redacted_explanation: Runtime image references must be checked against target policy and availability before activation.

objects.name: system_maintenance_locks
objects.redacted_explanation: Gate generation, fencing and bounded deadlines are installation-local coordination state and must start empty on a restored installation.

objects.name: system_maintenance_mutation_leases
objects.redacted_explanation: Mutation leases bind writer operation identity to a gate generation and bounded database time; they are never restored or replayed.

objects.name: system_maintenance_participants
objects.redacted_explanation: Participant generation, pause ACK, checkpoint and watchdog resume facts are installation-local coordination records; restored control tables must start empty.

objects.name: system_restore_drill_resources
objects.redacted_explanation: Restore resource intents, owner HMACs and cleanup evidence are target-local control records; B-owned target resources and bytes are not restored or defined by D.

objects.name: system_restore_drills
objects.redacted_explanation: Drill rows keep only D-owned task state plus typed source, target-config hash and evidence references; B-owned restore inventory is not copied into the task row.
